review_description: I am very happy with Eco Bay Electrical Pty Ltd following their installation of our new 8kW solar system (Sungrow inverter and Winaico solar panels). The advice they gave was spot on and the installation and service were outstanding. I was dreading the process because I'd heard of the bad experiences of others. Our experience was completely trouble-free, within a very quick timeline. I value both honesty and good workmanship and I believe that we received both from Eco Bay Electrical. The fact that I'm completing this review speaks volumes because I generally avoid reviews like the plaque. However, I feel that Eco Bay gave me the benefit of their time and service, so I would like to respond appropriately. The installation was managed in a very tidy and workmanlike manner with extra time given to moving our TV antenna and hiding the cabling behind the brickwork. The after sales service has been good, too, as I had a couple of queries which were received courteously and answered thoroughly. Our system has been in place now since early October 2024 and we regularly refer to the Sungrow smart meter for updates on its efficiency and effectiveness. Sincere thanks to Mitch and Craig for their work on our behalf!

Eco Bay Electrical impressed us from the beginning. The owner of the company who also does the installation was knowledgeable and friendly. There was no hard sales pitch just honest facts.The installation went with out a hitch and the quality of the workmanship was excellent. They showed us how to install the app and it is a simple process to monitor how much solar we're generating. The connection to the grid was arranged by Eco Bay. I'd highly recommend Mitch and his team.

Having "attempted" to get details & quotes 5+ years ago and then compare the vagaries of each one at the time (as well as trusted installers) it was a nightmare. I like to think of it as comparing mobile plans in the dark ages when they first came out!This time around using SolarQuotes I was put in contact with 3x verified installers, all of which made making a decision difficult. In the end I personally found the right balance with Eco Bay Electrical. They weren't necessarily the cheapest or the dearest but were as competitive in terms of competitive product offerings (panels/inverter) and installation. The install was slightly complicated by needing a switchboard refit which I was already aware of - all of which was verified via a very prompt visit to site as part of the initial response.From here a final plan was produced & even with lots of questions from me a few times the team was patient, polite, knowledgeable, and helpful.Once the install schedule was determined (very quick turn around), they arrived on site, did the install, and made all arrangements for energy company integration, grid connection, and metering update - all of which was done by them with zero requirement from me -> aka. perfect, I had to do nothing.From day #1 the system has been running flawlessly and I have every expectation it will do so into the future. I can confidently recommend Mitch and the team at Eco Bay Electrical.

We used Finn Peacock's Solar Quotes to source the three solar installers from whom we received quotes. We would have been comfortable going with any one of the three. They were all very good.Mitch and "Eco Bay" stood out because of the great price and apparent knowledge of all things solar. Outstanding for a comparatively young bloke (Mitch just turned 31 while on our job). It was a bonus that Mitch was also accredited for the Qld Government "Battery Booster" scheme.Mitch climbed onto our roof when he called to provide our quote and made a point of locating solar panels in the most efficient spots. He even relocated our existing TV antenna so that it wouldn't cast a shadow on the solar panels. Unbelievably even the small shadow of the TV antenna would have reduced efficiency. Mitch also installed a smaller heater element in our hot water system to better match with solar generation and help maximise efficiency.Mitch was reliable for punctuality and very pleasant to deal with. He sorted out connection with the grid and he will continue to keep a watch on our systems performance via the Sungrow App.We were so impressed by the whole experience that we got Mitch back to do some other electrical work for us.
The only quote we had where the sales person was the installer, and he was the only one that climbed up on the roof before he gave us a quote. Family business - great service from start to finish.

Can’t speak highly enough of Mitch and his team from EcoBay Electrical. The whole process from arranging for a quote through to the installation of our solar system was  professional, thorough and friendly. I would highly recommend this company to anyone considering solar installation.

Eco Bay are a small family-owned business. Of the several companies I approached for quotes they were the only ones that did an on-site inspection rather than relying on Google maps satellite view. They talked me through the process and provided lots of useful written information on the process and products to help me decide.Due to bad weather the job was unable to be completed in one day and was scheduled to be completed on another. Unfortunately, SE QLD experienced a significant weather event with effects of a cyclone and then extremely hot and humid weather. Mitch from Eco Bay, arrived on the hottest day of the year to complete the job, definitely above and beyond normal customer service. Eco Bay kept me informed throughout the process and contacted the necessary companies to organise the switch to solar and the grid connection. I would highly recommend this company.

The sales and quoting process was easy and Mitch was able to provide useful information and present options.The installation was first class and the team were a pleasure to deal with.Customer service is clearly a focus for this company.  Every task has been smooth, well organised and complete.
Mitch provided great end to end support. Would recommend Eco Bay

When we started our search for a solar panel installer, Mitch was the only one to climb on the roof. That's when I learned that he was the installer too. what's better than someone who knows what he's talking about. During the installation, everything went well: precise, efficient and clean work. All the procedures with Energex and our energy supplier were carried out by Craig (the father of Mitch) who takes care of all the administrative part. Thank you Eco Bay Electrical
Very smooth and effortless. Quick and efficient install. Can’t ask for more.

Had two other quotes given but decided on Eco Bay Electrical, glad I did for these reasons:- onsite inspection with questions explained simply and clearly- the quote was competitive but without loss of quality components- professional installation and on time- mobile app monitoring software installed and explained- after sales response excellentDefinitely recommend this company.

Customer service was great by MitchHe organised everything and did the job with 2 othersThey were on time and 3 did the install in one dayThey organised the grid connectionWe didn’t have to do anythingFascinating watching each of them carry a panel up a ladder like walking up a staircaseI have given them further electrical business as a result of their efficiency and customer service

You get what you pay for and I got good service, great products and peace of mind.Quotes were great, options clearly laid out. No pressure applied at all, answered all my queries and concerns and was nothing but pleasant throughout the whole process. No stuffing around, last minute changes or short cuts. They did what they said they would when they said they would. Can’t speak highly enough of the service from start to finish from the whole team.

Mitch and the guys are absolute weapons. No bullshit with the quote. Actually got on the roof to have a look!Install is amazing. So neat and specific to our house! The guys did an incredible job. Couldn't recommended them more!!!!Don't bother with any one else these guys are the best

Mitch, Craig & the Eco Bay Team were fantastic and easy to work with. They accommodated my many questions and took the time to explain things to me. I admit that I do not have enough knowledge about solar installation and what to look for so to have Craig and Mitch explain in a way that wasn't condescending was refreshing. Communication in the lead up to the installation and afterwards was brilliant and easy. I definitely would recommend them! Thank you for connecting us Solar Quotes

I found Eco Bay Electrical via the Solar Quotes website and had a call back within 24hrs with an on-site quote arranged for the following day, and an install 2 weeks later - absolutely fantastic turnaround time and great communication from both Mitch and his dad Craig.I thought the quote was well priced, and matched with what we discussed during the on site visit. I've had friends remark that they thought I did really well to find such a good deal for a 3-phase double storey install.Mitch and his team were prompt and friendly on both days (they were nearly blown off the roof it was so windy the first day and had to come back the next day to do the panels). The work is clean and tidy, and the "Sunny Covers" inverter enclosure looks great.Thanks again Eco Bay, but please send help - I'm getting addicted to my usage graphs!

The team at Eco Bay Electrical were very patient with us with delays on installing our of our collective control after we had engaged to install. Roof leak repairs by others. There was constant discussions to keep updated when we could schedule works after these repairs were completed.Mitch & the team were very easy to deal with in the quoting process, very prompt to engage with us to do a site inspection to ensure the most optimal system was installed for us. They listened to the queries I had and requests for system and provided appropriate answers to these queries and requests.Craig was easy to deal with to keep updated on works, scheduling of install, as well as details on what to expect post install with supply authority and retailer processes.First installation day of two was a little hampered by intermittent rain, but the Mitch & the Eco Bay Electrical team were able to install the system without issue. Second day was completing the inverter install and switchboard modifications.They listened to and worked with myself to ensure in ceiling layout of connecting wiring and adjustments of switchboard worked well.Thank you Mitch, Craig and Team. Very happy with the system so far.

Mitch and his team were fantastic to deal with.  Prompt, professional with fantastic workmanship.  Great advice given on the exact set up of our system and what would work best for us.  They managed all the paperwork, including helping organising grid connection after the install.  The install itself was seamless and the team were polite, friendly and more than happy to answer all my endless annoying questions.  It was definitely refreshing to deal with a team that value good ol fashion customer service and honesty and take pride in both the quality of the products they install and how they install them.  Would absolutely use Eco Bay Electrical again and would recommend them to anyone needing Solar......in fact our neighbor has already signed up for a system with them.

Mitch came to our house and answered all of our questions with calmness and thoughtfulness, no matter how many times we asked them. No question was considered stupid. He clearly explained what he thought we needed and WHY that was suitable for our house. He listened to what we wanted and then went off and prepared a quote that he sent to us when he said it would be sent.The installation was a totally pain-free process for us. Mitch and his co-worker arrived when he said they would. They were polite and pleasant at all times, taking time to answer more of our questions when we asked. They would have to be the tidiest and most pleasant tradespeople we've met in years. Polite. Tidy. Punctual.Best of all, Mitch handled all the annoying paperwork for us.We never do online reviews but we had such a positive experience that we think this is one small company that really deserves to be praised.

Thanks again Mitch-Coming from the building industry, and knowing the challenges in this buoyant market, it is refreshing to see someone turn up on time and charge a fair rate .Appreciate your efforts on a difficult install.I would recommend you to everyoneSteele

Quoting was good, they had flexibility on panels and inverter. And understood the tech to recommend some cost effective but still good choices.Installation was done in 2 days, which is fast for a system this big. The team were all friendly.Grid connection was no hassle, as they organised it properly and I just double checked it was scheduled in.These guys are worth working with and more friendly than the competitors who quoted.
